findings: Service-layer N+1 queries — ToResponseAsync calls repository methods in loops, triggering separate database queries for every session/schedule. Refactor to use SQL JOINs in repositories or batch-fetch related entities before mapping.

No caching for repeated entities — Fetching 50 sessions from the same trainer queries the trainer record 50 times. Add in-memory caching at the service layer or repository layer for trainer/facility/member lookups within a single request.

schedules.js null handling gap — The file directly accesses schedule.trainerName and schedule.facilityName without || '-' guards. Verify these fields are always populated or add null checks in the frontend.

Completion report architectural mismatch — Report describes 'Entity Framework Include' as the approach and mentions Dapper as an afterthought. The project uses Dapper exclusively. This confusion could mislead future developers reading the report.

Missing performance testing note — The completion report acknowledges potential N+1 issues but doesn't flag them as blocking. At 100+ sessions, this will cause noticeable latency. Production readiness requires performance validation or query optimization.
